Les alertes décochées restent enregistré: Unticked alerts are still recorded in the logs and on the dashboard, without a mail.

A restart puts the device in alert for the chosen time; so does a lost Internet connection. Tick "also on alert (degraded)" to get a mail.

Mesurées sur le multiplex reçu. Un mail: Measured on the received multiplex. A mail is sent at the alert, a second at the restoration. "Listen" opens the Logger tab at the time of the alert, for the watched station and alerts on the whole multiplex.
Multiplex reçu par la clé RTL-SDR et wel: Multiplex received by the RTL-SDR dongle and welle-cli

Alerts that start together are flagged: a common upstream cause is likely. "Listen" opens the FM logger at the time of the alert.

Silence and degraded ensemble count once the DAB+ alert has fired, after their delay. DAB+ mails are already sent from the DAB+ page: leave this device's email alert unticked to avoid duplicates.

Place it next to FM reception, on the same site.

À chaque relevé, BL-RMO écoute le flux q: At each reading, BL-RMO listens to the stream for a few seconds, like a listener: is audio arriving, at what level, which title? A silence longer than the chosen time puts the stream in alert (tick "also on alert (degraded)" for the mail). Listeners and bitrate come from the Icecast server status page when it is public. Recommended interval: 30 to 60 s. Place it on the Reception site, next to FM and DAB+.
